entries.title: The sign-in screen comes back once no subscription is connected, even with an AI key in your environment
entries.body: An AI provider key set in your computer's environment variables no longer counts as a connected subscription. Before, such a key could hide the sign-in screen on a fresh install, most often on Windows, and the screen stayed hidden after an uninstall or after removing every subscription.
entries.noPicture: The existing sign-in screen now appears when it should; the screen itself does not change.
